metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired simultaneously from two participants using 32-channel systems per participant (64 channels total) in BrainVision format. Participants performed 8 tone sequences (4 musical duets and 4 constant pitch sequences) with 5 joint trials per sequence, yielding 40 test trials per pair. Behavioral synchronization performance was calculated as the mean absolute asynchrony between participants' note onsets normalized by inter-onset interval, with standard deviation computed across all beats per trial. Joint agency was assessed using a 1-7 self-report rating scale.
